Identical to EXP-001 except ENABLE_BETA off->1; BG_STATS_PATH NOT passed (USE_IDF=0, pure TF). No fix-and-retry per contract.
observations: Enabling ENABLE_BETA=1 CRASHED the closed-form Phase-2 update; EXP-001 (identical config, beta off) completed cleanly, so the failure is attributable to the single variable under test. beta WAS genuinely engaged and non-trivial: _should_fit_beta returned True, refit_beta_nnls (NNLS projected-gradient, w_j=exp(beta_j)>=0) ran per head, cache.enable_attention_bias(True) was called, and the saved partial cache (cache-after-doc-002) carries attention_bias_enabled=True with trainable_beta non-zero across all 36 layers (max |beta_logweight|=66.6, mean=4.23, ~19.4% of entries non-zero, consistent with beta_fit_scope=selected touching only top-T slots). The per-document loop successfully wrote docs 000/001/002 (cache-after-doc-000..002 + cache-step1..3 saved) then died on document index 3 with torch._C._LinAlgError: linalg.cholesky ... not positive-definite in _ridge_lstsq (core.py:225), raised from guarded_sparse_am_value_update(..., attention_bias=head_beta) (finetune.py:546, value_solve.py:247). Mechanism: attention_bias=beta is added to the attention logits pre-softmax inside compute_attention_weights, so the very large fitted log-weights (up to ~66.6, exp of which overflows) collapse the softmax attention onto near-one-hot, making the value-solve design matrix X rank-deficient; X^T X is then non-positive-definite and Cholesky fails in BOTH the primary and the except-branch ridge-floor(>=1e-6) retry (RIDGE_LAMBDA=1e-4 spectral is too small to rescue a numerically singular normal matrix). Because the crash preceded the aggregate/eval stage, NO phase2_summary.json was written and NEITHER QA-forgetting NOR MT-acquisition eval ran, so both loss numbers are null (not fabricated) and the HYP-T2 question (does beta close the MT-acquisition gap without hurting QA) is UNANSWERED by this run. Cost: phase2_e2e_s=369s wall (cold model load + flex_attention autotune/compile + 3 docs + crash) on flock-claimed GPU1; solve_s/gpu_s/value_global_max_abs unavailable (no summary); gradient_steps=0. Caveat: this is a numerical-stability failure of the beta/NNLS mass-bias path under these ridge settings, not necessarily a claim that beta is unhelpful.
failure_cause: torch._C._LinAlgError: linalg.cholesky: input not positive-definite, in cartridges/am/core.py:225 (_ridge_lstsq, except-branch retry) <- value_solve.py:247 guarded_sparse_am_value_update(attention_bias=head_beta) <- finetune.py:546 <- continual.py:199 <- continual_am_sparse.py:362/579. Triggered on document index 3 (docs 0-2 succeeded). Root cause: ENABLE_BETA=1 fits large NNLS log-weight biases (max |beta|~66.6) that are added to attention logits pre-softmax, collapsing the softmax attention to near-one-hot and making the value-solve design matrix rank-deficient; X^T X becomes non-positive-definite and Cholesky fails in both the primary solve and the raised-ridge-floor fallback (RIDGE_LAMBDA=1e-4 spectral insufficient). Beta was confirmed engaged (attention_bias_enabled=True, non-zero trainable_beta on all 36 layers in cache-after-doc-002).
